lines.text: Jehoshaphat returned safely to Jerusalem, and Jehu son of Hanani told him the LORD's wrath was upon him for helping the wicked.
Jehu said Jehoshaphat had removed the Asherah poles, and Jehoshaphat then went out from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim.
Jehoshaphat appointed judges in each fortified city of Judah and told them they were judging for the king.
In Jerusalem he appointed Levites, priests, and family heads as judges, and told them to warn people so they would not incur guilt.
Zebadiah the chief priest was over all that pertained to the LORD, and Amariah was over all that pertained to the king.
